preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 58 inclusive.
Each of the n-1 lines describing arcs must contain exactly two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n] for num in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each arc destination must be a vertex number between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 5000 inclusive.
Each query must contain exactly two parts: vertex v and string s.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) < n for line in stdin.splitlines()[n+1:])
preconditions.description: The vertex v in each query must be between 1 and n-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()[1]) == n-1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[n+1:])
preconditions.description: The string s in each query must have length n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'R', 'B'} for line in stdin.splitlines()[n+1:] for c in line.split()[1])
preconditions.description: Each character in string s must be either 'R' or 'B'.

postconditions.description: Each output line must contain exactly one integer or -1.
Each output must be either -1 or a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line.strip()) == -1 or int(line.strip()) >= 0 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Output must be either -1 (unreachable) or a non-negative integer (time).

postconditions.expression: all((int(line.strip()) == -1) or (0 <= int(line.strip()) <= 2**(n-1) - 1) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If reachable, the time must be within the possible bounds (0 to 2^(n-1) - 1).

postconditions.expression: all((int(line.strip()) == -1) or (stdin.splitlines()[n+1+i].split()[0] == str(v) and stdin.splitlines()[n+1+i].split()[1] == s) == (int(line.strip()) == time) for i, (v, s) in enumerate(get_queries()))
postconditions.description: For each query, if the state (v, s) is reachable, the output must be the first time t_i it appears; otherwise, output -1.
